# The Last Click

> The Last Click is an AI-first product studio in Athens, Greece. Bring us the work — a product, a service, a process, an idea — and we turn it into a live AI experience that people actually use. Not a deck, not a prototype in a folder: something running, in front of real users, doing real work.

Legal name: THE LAST CLICK L.P. · Athens (Maroussi), Greece · Founded by Jim Tsipoutas (https://jimtsipoutas.com)

## What we build
- **AI-first products and agents** — voice agents, assistants, automations, and the interfaces that make them feel inevitable. The model, the plumbing, and the judgment about which of the three is the hard part.
- **Mobile apps and games** — native, from the first sketch to a passed review. We have shipped our own, so we know where it bites.
- **Web apps and design systems** — interfaces that stay coherent as they grow, and the system underneath that keeps them that way.

## How we work
Four gates, in order, and AI is inside every one of them:
1. **Frame** — AI reads the brief, the market and the edge cases with us. We find the real problem before anyone opens an editor.
2. **Design** — AI drafts twenty directions; taste picks one. Decisions are cheap on a canvas and we make a lot of them, fast.
3. **Build** — AI writes alongside us: weeks, not quarters. It raises the floor; judgment raises the ceiling.
4. **Ship** — AI runs inside the product and around it: monitoring, support, the next iteration. Compiling isn't finished.

## Track record
Everything we sell came out of building something real first. Our own products are live; our own AI agents answer the phone. We are our own most demanding client.

## Things we have shipped
- [Padlboard](https://padlboard.ai) — padel scoring for Apple Watch and iPhone.
- [BoomBoats](https://boomboats.com) — a voxel Battleship game.
- [Wild Rush](https://thewildrush.com) — an obstacle-course racing game.
- [Cookonomics](https://cookonomics.com) — food costing and margins for restaurants and food businesses.
- [FlexUI](https://flexui.ai) — an API-driven design system that keeps AI coding tools on brand.

Use the form at https://thelastclick.gr/#contact — tell us the idea you cannot stop thinking about, and we will tell you honestly whether we are the right people to build it.
